detection.weighting: Equal source weight within each class; all sizes/seeds from one source stay together
detection.combinedRule: Exact old public-code positives outrank negatives; the training-only linear score of all 22 features breaks ties.
detection.decisionRule: Per candidate/useful-byte load against legacy-filler-on: complete-format paired 95% AUC interval (baseline minus candidate) strictly above zero; achieved test TPR and FPR no higher at both fixed validation targets; no salt-only or old-code-only perfect test ranking newly absent from baseline. Otherwise inconclusive. All loads must pass for a profile-wide claim.
detection.scope: Exploratory source-separated results on adaptively reused photos; never population invisibility, a safe capacity, production readiness or phone approval.
